about.background: I studied Visual Communication Design at university and spent those years learning everything I could get my hands on, with a soft spot for clean, editorial design that has never quite worn off. BEECH hired me straight out of uni. I started there on poster and merch design, moved into websites not long after, and I haven’t really stopped since. Those poster years never really left me, and editorial web design is where the two halves meet: big type, a clear hierarchy, everything in its right place and nothing in the way.
about.body: I design websites and digital products from the first sketch to the final build, alongside brand identity and print. I like work that feels calm and considered, the sort you can use without having to think about it. I care as much about how something moves as how it looks. If you’d like to talk design, or just say hi, I’d genuinely love to hear from you.
about.intro: Hey, I’m Lachlan Sarv, a digital & graphic designer from Newcastle, NSW. By day I’m the Lead UI/UX Designer at BEECH Agency. Kodu Studio is where I keep the rest of it: agency work I’ve had a hand in, client projects, and the things I make simply because I want to.

approach.faqIntro: These are the questions that come up before most projects. If there’s something else you’re wondering about, just ask. I’m always happy to talk it through.

faqs.answer: A single page site is usually three to four weeks. A full site with brand work behind it runs eight to twelve. Most of that is strategy and design, the build is the quick part. I only take on a small number of client projects a year, so yours is never sitting in a queue waiting for me to get to it.
faqs.question: How long does a project take?

faqs.answer:
Most of my sites are built with Astro and hosted on Cloudflare, so they load fast even on a phone with one bar of reception. I’d rather make a simple site that does its job properly than a complicated one that doesn’t, and for bigger or more custom builds I bring in a developer I trust.

If you’d like to update things yourself later, I can set you up with Sanity, a simple editor for changing your own text and images. It depends a little on the size of the project, so we’ll talk it through.
faqs.question: How do you build the sites?

faqs.answer: Everything is quoted as a fixed fee once we’ve scoped it out on a call, so there are no hourly surprises at the end. The number tracks the size of the site and how much brand and strategy work sits behind it. If you’ve got a budget you need to stay inside, tell me early and I’ll be straight with you about what fits.
faqs.question: What does it cost?

faqs.answer: Some time early on, and the honest version of your business. A kickoff call, whatever you already have (logos, photography, copy, analytics), and one person who can give feedback and make the calls. If copy or photography is missing, I’ll tell you before we start rather than halfway through.
faqs.question: What do you need from me?

faqs.answer: Happily, if you want me to. Hosting on Cloudflare is cheap, and I can keep it running, make changes as you need them and keep an eye on how it’s performing. If you’d rather own the whole thing outright, that’s completely fine too. I hand it over with documentation and no lock in.
faqs.question: Do you look after the site after launch?

faqs.answer: Yes, of course. If you’ve got a brand you’re happy with, I’ll work inside it rather than try to reinvent it. And if you’ve got a developer or an internal marketing team, I can design and hand over, or build alongside them.
faqs.question: Can you work with my existing brand or team?

approach.intro: Every project starts from the same brief: a site that looks considered and has a real job to do. It should tell your story, show people what sets your brand apart, and point visitors toward the next step.

steps.description: It starts with a call, then the research. I look at what you’re selling, who’s buying it and why, then shape that into positioning and a story that sounds like you rather than everyone else. I dig into how those people actually behave too, so the design is built to convert from the very first sketch.
steps.name: Strategy

steps.description: This is my favourite part. I design brands and websites that are clear, considered and full of personality, and I’m happy to work in whatever direction suits you rather than bending every project to one style. Wherever we land, the aim is the same: let your brand carry the page, and give visitors one unmistakable reason to act.
steps.name: Design

steps.description: I build everything to perform exactly as well as it looks. That might be a brand identity structured to scale cleanly across every platform, or a website that loads instantly on a phone. It matters, because a sharp design that’s clunky to use or slow to arrive still loses people.
steps.name: Build

sections.body: At kodustudio.com I collect as little as I can get away with: enough to know which work people look at, and nothing more. This policy sets out what is collected, why, and what happens to it. There are no forms on this site, nothing is sold, and nothing is shared beyond the services listed below.
sections.heading: Privacy Policy

sections.body: Kodu Studio, run by Lachlan Sarv in Newcastle, NSW, Australia. If you have a question about any of this, or you want something removed, email kodudesignstudio@gmail.com and it comes straight to me.
sections.heading: Who is responsible for your data?

sections.body: The site uses Google Analytics 4 and Vercel Web Analytics to count visits and see which projects get looked at. Between them they record the pages you view, roughly where in the world you are, and the browser and device you are on. It tells me what is worth showing more of. It is not used to identify you, and I never try to. Google processes this data on my behalf, and you can opt out of it entirely with Google’s browser add-on.
sections.heading: Analytics

sections.body: Google Analytics sets cookies so it can tell a returning visit from a new one. The site itself saves exactly one thing in your browser: whether you chose light or dark mode. That never leaves your device and is not sent anywhere.
sections.heading: Cookies and local storage

sections.body: The site is hosted on Vercel and served through their network. Like any web host, their servers keep standard request logs that include IP addresses, for security and reliability.
sections.heading: Hosting

sections.body: One project page embeds a YouTube video through youtube-nocookie.com, which stops YouTube setting tracking cookies unless you actually press play. If you do play it, YouTube’s own privacy policy takes over from there.
sections.heading: Embedded video

sections.body: The typefaces are served from this site rather than from a font provider, so loading a page does not quietly tell a third party that you visited.
sections.heading: Fonts

sections.body: You can ask what is held about you and ask for it to be deleted, and you can opt out of the analytics at any time using an ad blocker, your browser’s tracking protection, or Google’s opt-out add-on. Nothing on this site breaks if you do. Email me and I will sort out anything else.
sections.heading: Your rights

sections.body: If any of this changes, the date at the top of the page changes with it.
sections.heading: Changes to this policy

settings.contactHeading: Like what you see? Let’s talk.
settings.contactIntro: Whether it’s a brand that needs a look, a website that needs building, or just a rough idea you want to kick around, I’d love to hear what you’re working on.
